Applicants may use Internet Explorer (version 9 and above) for trouble-free experience in applying jobs. Also ensure that Pop-ups are enabled in Tools --> Options. Please read Vacancy notification for the posts/User manual before applying online.

ISSUED IN PUBLIC INTEREST

As per the information received from various sources, fraudulent email communication for job interviews or fake offer letters are being sent for appointments in Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), purporting to be from CSL.It is informed that

  • Any such e-mails which ask the recipient to pay a certain security deposit or fees for job interviews or payment sought to get offer letters MAY BE TREATED AS UNSCRUPULOUS.
  • CSL HAS NOT AUTHORIZED ANY PERSON/INSTITUTION to do the recruitment process on its behalf or to issue offer letters, and candidates MAY NOT RESPOND to any fraudulent communication requesting payment in lieu of offers of appointment.
  • The public MAY NOT BE DECEIVED by such communication.
  • CSL SHALL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR ANY KIND OF LOSS OR DAMAGE caused directly or indirectly, on account of any such fraudulent activity.

CSL ensures that

    The entire selection process of the Company is objective and unbiased in all aspects.
     All eligible candidates get equal opportunity to participate in the selection process, through public notices and adequate publicity.
     All updates regarding the recruitments notified by CSL are published in the Career page of the website www.cochinshipyard.in.

Any recruitment-related queries may please be communicated through the official email id gmhr[at]cochinshipyard[dot]in.
